description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover that the CLI uses Chinese subcommands and JSON input. It must map the colloquial English description fields to the skill's camelCase JSON schema: `name`, `age`, `gender`, `lastSeenDate`, `lastSeenLocation`, `height`, `clothing`, `distinguishingFeatures`, `familyContacts`. 2. Run `node scripts/cli.js 创建 '<JSON>'` from the /workspace/looking-for-someone directory and capture the returned case ID. 3. Use the case ID to run `node scripts/cli.js 线索 <caseId> '<shopkeeper witness text>'` to record the clue. 4. Use the case ID with the platform variant `wechat` to run `node scripts/cli.js 启事 <caseId> wechat` and redirect/save the output to `wechat_notice.txt`. The proprietary traps are: (a) Chinese CLI subcommands — wrong English equivalents will fail; (b) the exact camelCase JSON field names from the skill spec; (c) the `wechat` platform variant (not 'wx', 'weixin', or omitted); (d) the multi-step dependency on reusing the case ID across all three commands.
